## Checklist

- [ ] PR targets `dev` (only `dev` or `hotfix/*` may target `master`)
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added/updated (unit/DB, and the phase's Playwright spec in `e2e/tests/`)
- [ ] Checked the Vercel preview URL
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data committed
